decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed extensions, roof lights, and front porch are not harmful to neighbours' living conditions or the appearance of the building and the surrounding area.  They are in line with policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations), T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities For Developments) and the Residential Extension Guidelines of the adopted Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

(Reason.  To ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission)

Condition : 3 - The extension [building] hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 21 Alderney Avenue. 

(Reason.  The accommodation is considered unsuitable for occupation by a separate person or household not related to the occupiers of the single family dwelling to which it is attached, and such use would have a detrimental effect upon the character of the neighbourhood. )

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the eastern and western wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

(Reason.  To protect the amenities of the neighbouring residential property against increased overlooking)

Condition : 5 - The first floor windows formed in the eastern and western elevations shall be obscure glazed and fixed shut before the extensionhereby approved is first occupied, and shall be permanently maintained as such.

REASON:  To prevent overlooking of the neighbouring properties.
description: Retention of two storey side extension, part two storey and part single storey rear extension, roof lights, and front porch to house.
